name: ecl-ai-components
description: Europa Component Library (ECL) registry for AI coding agents. Self-contained, accessible European Commission / EU components with full adaptation and coordination metadata.

designSystem.name: Europa Component Library (ECL)
designSystem.notes: Ground truth: @ecl/preset-eu@5.3.1 dist/styles/ecl-eu.css, installed as an exact devDependency and declared to staticView.classCheck so drift is caught automatically. ECL ships 95 per-component packages as SCSS; the preset is the only compiled bundle. Upgraded 5.2.0 -> 5.3.1 on 2026-09-29 (no tile used any of the 10 classes removed between the versions).

metadataCategories.discovery: Facets for filtering in code (not sent to model)
metadataCategories.selection: useWhen/avoidWhen — helps choose the right component

highContrast.description: forced-colors / high-contrast mode support (ECL is WCAG-checked)

contentLanguages: 24 official EU languages via site-header selector

gaps.nearestAlternative: site-header tile (mega menu composes inside the site header)
gaps.reason: RESOLVED 2026-09-29: ecl-mega-menu is canon in ECL 5.3.1 (verified in @ecl/preset-eu@5.3.1) and observed live on home-affairs.ec.europa.eu and research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu — a tile candidate, no longer a blind deferral.
Not among the tiled ECL components
EC/EU pages embed skip links in site markup; the header tile documents the requirement

staticView.note: Resolved-view generation input (see _base/generate-resolved-view.mjs). Tiles are self-contained; no design-system CSS injection needed.
